name: ash-skills
description: Shared skills & commands used across my day-to-day workflows

review_context_files.title: Tech Lead Review: your goals notes
review_context_files.description: Optional. weekly-work-wrap can end with a Tech Lead Review: a short, critical read of your week with one thing to try next week. It measures the week against the notes you list here, so point it at notes describing your career goals, growth areas or role expectations. One or more note paths, vault-relative or absolute, eg: <folder>/Goals.md. Leave empty to turn the review off

company_name.title: Tech Lead Review: company
company_name.description: Optional, and only used when the Tech Lead Review is on. The review is written as a tech lead at this company, so the bar it holds your week to matches where you work, eg: Acme. Leave empty to propose one from your Jira site (acme.atlassian.net gives Acme)

sunsama_channel.title: Sunsama channel
sunsama_channel.description: Optional. Sunsama channel for tasks the skills create, eg: <channel>. Leave empty to be asked, or to create tasks without a channel

vault_path.title: Obsidian vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to the vault root, eg: /Users/<username>/Documents/Obsidian/<vault>. The vault name is the last folder in this path. Leave empty to use the vault registered in Obsidian (you're asked if there are several)

weekly_log_folder.title: Weekly log folder
weekly_log_folder.description: Folder for weekly logs, relative to the vault root (don't include the vault path), eg: <folder>/Weekly Work Logs/{YEAR}. Replace the <...> parts with your own. Type {YEAR} exactly as shown: don't enter an actual year, the skills fill in the current one. Leave empty for 10 - Meetings/Weekly Work Logs/{YEAR}

log_filename_format.title: Weekly log filename
log_filename_format.description: Filename for a week's log, dated by that week's Monday. Type the letters exactly as shown, uppercase: MM is the month, DD the day, YY the two-digit year, so MM-DD-YY.md gives 03-16-26.md. Leave empty to match the files already in the weekly log folder (MM-DD-YY.md if there are none)

weekly_log_template.title: Weekly log template note
weekly_log_template.description: Template note for a new week's log, relative to the vault root (don't include the vault path), eg: <templates-folder>/Weekly Work Log.md. Replace the <...> part with your own folder. Leave empty to use the note named Weekly Work Log in your templates folder

standup_folder.title: Standup folder
standup_folder.description: Folder for standup notes, relative to the vault root (don't include the vault path), eg: <folder>/<team> Standup. Leave empty for a folder ending in Standup under 10 - Meetings

standup_template.title: Standup template note
standup_template.description: Template note for a standup, relative to the vault root, eg: <templates-folder>/Standup Template.md. Leave empty to use the note named Standup Template in your templates folder

dev_note_folder.title: Dev note folder
dev_note_folder.description: Folder for dev notes (one per ticket), relative to the vault root (don't include the vault path), eg: <folder>/<project>/Dev. Leave empty for the Dev folder under 20 - Projects (you're asked if there are several)

dev_note_template.title: Dev note template note
dev_note_template.description: Template note for a dev note, relative to the vault root, eg: <templates-folder>/Development Template.md. Leave empty to use the note named Development Template in your templates folder

team_context_file.title: Team note
team_context_file.description: Note listing your teammates' names, roles and who goes first in standup, relative to the vault root, eg: <team> Team.md. Leave empty to use a vault-root note whose name ends in Team or Squad, else a list of names built from Jira

jira_site.title: Jira site
jira_site.description: Jira site host, without https://, eg: <company>.atlassian.net. Usually set by /ash-skills:setup. Leave empty to use the site the Atlassian MCP reports

jira_project.title: Jira project key
jira_project.description: Key of your team's Jira project, eg: PROJ. Usually set by /ash-skills:setup. Leave empty to use the key most of your open sprint tickets share

story_points_field.title: Jira story points field
story_points_field.description: Id of the story points custom field, which differs per Jira site, eg: customfield_<number>. Usually set by /ash-skills:setup. Leave empty to find it by name in Jira's field metadata
